properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...

White River from Muncie to Spencer.

Fall Creek at Millersville.

Fall Creek near Fortville.

.Widespread flooding continues along the White River and associated
tributaries. Major flooding is ongoing along the White near and
north of Indianapolis, including the Noblesville, Nora, and
Ravenswood areas. The crest along the White is currently near the
Indianapolis Museum of Art, and may reach Raymond Street by daybreak
Sunday. The expected crest height at the Raymond Street gauge has
increased to 20.8 feet. The crest will not reach Centerton until
Monday afternoon, and points further southwest later than that.

* WHAT...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...White River at Ravenswood.

* WHEN...Until early Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.5 feet, Major flooding in Ravenswood.  Evacuations
ordered for all residents in Ravenswood west of Crittenden
Avenue.  Water near the top of levee protecting Rocky Ripple.
Water at critical levels for Warfleigh levee in Broad Ripple.
Numerous local roads extensively flooded on the north side of
Indianapolis.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- There is no current observed data.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
Wednesday afternoon and continue falling and remain below
flood stage.
- Flood stage is 6.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement should be issued Sunday afternoon by around 1215
PM EDT.
